task: ARCH2 turn-based single-network speech-to-speech: evaluate Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct as a candidate vs the proven MiniCPM-o primary
hardware: NVIDIA RTX A6000 48GB (GPU1 only, CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1)

package_versions.transformers: 5.13.0 (upgraded from 5.12.1 during this task to test packed-MoE compressed-tensors loading)

models_evaluated.role: community int4 (compressed-tensors pack-quantized) to attempt 48GB fit

measured_turn_metrics_note: STEP 2 was not reached: the smoke gate (load + run native audio-out within 48 GB) failed, so no TTFA/RTF/turn-total were measured and no demo wav was produced. No metrics or audio were fabricated.
recommendation: MiniCPM-o remains the ARCH2 primary. Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct is a strong turn-based S2S architecture but does not fit a single 48 GB A6000 with its audio-out (talker) path in the current stack.
caveats: bf16 requires ~80 GB (multi-GPU); official min 78.85 GB for the Instruct thinker+talker.
bitsandbytes cannot quantize the fused MoE experts (custom Qwen3OmniMoeThinkerTextExperts, not nn.Linear).
The community int4 checkpoint stores experts int4 on disk but transformers decompresses them to bf16 at load (DecompressExperts) -> still ~64 GB.

CPU-offload load succeeds but inference crashes on an accelerate-offload vs compressed_tensors quantized_forward incompatibility; not viable without patching library internals, and would be far too slow for turn-based S2S regardless.

A future path exists on hardware >= ~80 GB (e.g. H100/A100-80G or 2x A6000) in bf16, or if/when a true-int4 fused-MoE runtime (e.g. vLLM with audio-out, or GPTQ/AWQ kernels for the fused experts) lands.
